title: 1996 AHSME Problem 5
statement: Given that \(0\lt a\lt b\lt c\lt d,\) which of the following is the largest?

solutions.text: Among the displayed numerators, \(c+d\) is largest; among the denominators, \(a+b\) is smallest. Therefore \(\frac{c+d}{a+b}\) exceeds every other positive fraction listed, so the correct answer is E.
hints: A positive fraction grows when its numerator increases or its denominator decreases
Compare every numerator and denominator with \(c+d\) and \(a+b\), respectively
